baseline.working_tree_note: This records the initial uncommitted static-review pin at 98e5. A later frozen candidate and recorded consumer-wave receipt are added below; the initial source hashes remain preserved in the source lease.

verdict.summary: The frozen candidate passes the recorded 10-test consumer wave, including the real cubic N5-to-CAS-to-fresh-default-N8 witness and EMP intake controls. The source remains simulation-only and reports time, unit, and sampling uncertainty as not_established. The ordinary served three-atom GET positive remains unverified, so B26 closure is still not adjudicated.

criterion_review.criterion: B26 / SIM-03: the three-atom cubic case must not be described as globally additive; expose checked order and residual without identifying a mechanism.
Complete unique individual, pairwise, and joint scopes with trajectory step labels exactly matching the persisted N5 horizon.
criterion_review.evidence: _recompute_conditional_interaction_evidence builds the full scope set from atom cardinality, rejects duplicate/missing/extra scopes, and compares every trajectory's step tuple with result.horizon.steps().

criterion_review.criterion: Recompute higher-order residual from numerical effects, and reconcile stored top-level and feedback residual copies plus the checked-order claim.
criterion_review.evidence: The helper calculates joint effect minus individual effects minus pairwise excess effects; it compares that result to both stored residual maps and compares feedback checked_interaction_orders to the recomputed order tuple. It does not consult PairwiseInteractionTerms or numeric_interaction.

criterion_review.criterion: Scope the typed diagnostic so it does not claim physical units/time or a causal maximum; report four-or-more atom remainder as aggregate three-plus.
criterion_review.evidence: ConditionalSimulationInteractionEvidence fixes predicate_provenance=recomputed, authority_purpose=conditional_simulation_only, unit_binding_status=not_established, and time_binding_status=not_established. max_checked_interaction_order reports the largest checked numerical order; for four-or-more atoms residual_scope is aggregate_three_plus and checked orders stop at two. The frozen contract also fixes sampling_uncertainty_status=not_established; this is only an explicit boundary literal, not an uncertainty estimate.

criterion_review.criterion: Preserve historical/partial N5 intake and keep the public GET projection typed.
criterion_review.evidence: The canonical load_joint_simulation_result implementation is unchanged. The legacy v1/no-limitation path still returns to the pre-existing EvalSafety flow; partial or v2 candidate inputs pass through the new fail-closed reconciliation. run_lifecycle maps the evidence into ConditionalSimulationObservation, which is nested in the GET response projection.

criterion_review.criterion: Preserve the exact registered B25 SMM regression block.
criterion_review.evidence: The complete test_sim_03.py Git blob at baseline and working tree is 7b5ed26ee97b4485c3d2c5dc6d6a2b40cf1cc202; all three required original function bodies are unchanged.

criterion_review.criterion: Preserve numerical uncertainty when the interaction residual is based on few repetitions.
criterion_review.evidence: The new diagnostic recomputes a point residual from the persisted trajectory effects and carries no typed sampling-uncertainty estimate. SIM-03 B26 names this requirement; an E-owned producer uncertainty contract is outside this source delta and must supply any estimator. The frozen candidate adds a strict sampling_uncertainty_status Literal set to not_established, and the cubic test asserts it; no IID/QMC or precision claim is introduced.

residuals.bucket: same B26 class one level deeper (P40), not a new class
residuals.detail: The new field is wired through the run lifecycle service and typed GET response. The recorded consumer wave passed the direct fresh-process cubic N5-to-N8 path, but it did not exercise an admitted three-atom ordinary served run followed by GET. The existing served-cycle GET assertion does not mention conditional_interaction_evidence; the progress ledger already describes this input as absent.
residuals.smallest_closure: Add or extend one ordinary served-cycle test with an admitted three-atom cubic N5 result and assert the GET's recomputed residual, checked orders, aggregate/third-order scope, not_established unit/time, and simulation-only authority purpose.

baseline_red.interpretation: Expected RED: on the baseline, the fresh default N8 consumer returned no conditional interaction evidence and admitted content-valid false residual/order/scope variants. The test also contains real cubic NCM construction, fresh-process consumption, and property-removal controls. This is historical baseline evidence only.

pattern_pass.existing_pattern: B26 pairwise-only classification could overstate additivity of a complete design.
pattern_pass.target_pattern: Recompute bounded numerical coverage from complete persisted trajectories at the actual default N8 consumer; project it as an expressly simulation-only diagnostic.
pattern_pass.state: The bounded consumer path has a 10/10 recorded pass. Source-level GET projection is present; served three-atom verification remains open. P40 classifies the remaining gap as the same B26 class one level deeper.

limitations: The diagnostic is numerical simulation evidence only; causal correctness and mechanism identity are not established.
Physical unit and producer-time binding remain not_established; no B19/B21 timing authority is inferred.
Sampling uncertainty is explicitly not_established; the new Literal is not an estimator and no IID/QMC or precision inference is made.
The 10-test consumer wave is a recorded receipt read during this addendum, not a run performed by this reviewer.
No admitted three-atom ordinary served run followed by public GET is evidenced; the singleton producer regression was not included in this wave.
